why: record friction reported by OM-006 design unit 03: a disjunctive tag brief widens through shared words, and a path packet with --decisions reached no subject records

ops.section: 2026-10-17 brief: a tag disjunction widens through shared words, and a path packet reaches no subject records
ops.body: OM-006 design unit 03 ran `ks brief --tag 'mod-compatibility || save-files || game-update-compatibility'`. Because a term matches any tag sharing a word, `game-update-compatibility` pulled in every `in-game-testing` record, and the answer was the same broad testing set the unit already had. Expected: a term names one dictionary entry, or the brief offers an exact-term mode. Done instead: the unit read only the records whose own tags fit. The same unit's packet (`ks handoff --scope mods/just-fall-already/src .github/workflows/label-mod.yml --decisions`) spent its 8 KB on per-mod copies of the code-style sections and returned no decision records; the records that governed the design (the new-mod architecture trigger `blk-c8ecd5229a93`, the testing records) came only from tag queries the unit ran itself. Expected: a packet for a design unit reaches the subject records its spec names. Done instead: the manager passes `--tag` terms into later packets.
